Image5 is the primary drawing and dimensional-material quality reference: deep shadowed joints, powerful long-legged anatomy, large oblique armor planes, precise hand-drawn mechanical linework, restrained wear and no cheap toy flatness.

The complete core robot stands on the LEFT 42% of the canvas, full body with head/mane/feet uncropped. On the RIGHT arrange the three full vehicles vertically: bomber above, train in the middle, drill vehicle below. Every vehicle has enough space and clear separation. No combined robot on this sheet, no floating parts, no diagrams, text, letters, numbers, logos, captions or borders. This is a premium illustration, not an infographic.

1 CORE ROBOT: faithfully redraw Yongquan as the SAME strong, handsome complete mechanical hero, not a new face. Keep the approved head and long orange/ivory mane, the original armored torso and all FOUR limbs. Refine armor thickness and articulate deep neck/shoulder/elbow/knee joints. Long confident thighs and shins, substantial feet, broad V-shaped closed white chest, curved white face mask, bright cyan eyes limited to small apertures. Its existing fists stay large and proportional: they are its own reinforced hands, not tiny fists awaiting replacement. Strong broad orange forearm guards with narrow cyan wrist rings, angular white knuckle plates. Mane fans in controlled long orange-white mechanical-fiber strands behind head and shoulders, unmistakable lion identity, not fire, no organic animal head. Keep warm pure orange and ivory, do NOT borrow the navy/burgundy palette of the rendering references. Relaxed powerful standing pose, mature 8-head heroic proportions.

2 BOMBER: a complete twin-engine ducted-fan bomber in slightly elevated three-quarter perspective. The same orange central nose and blue canopy, charcoal broad swept wings with white leading-edge armor, EXACTLY TWO huge silver-rimmed dark fan nacelles at wing roots, twin orange/charcoal tail fins, compact orange/white structural shoulders. The central fuselage has clear large armor segments that can become chest/back armor; wings fold behind the combined shoulders, fans remain traceable. No tiny hanging truck, crew or landing diorama.

4 TWIN DRILL VEHICLE: one complete broad vehicle made from TWO mirrored connected halves. Each half has its own front tread group and rear tread group; the front treads can wrap the shins and the rear groups make boot heels in combination. Heavy orange frames under large ivory armor panels, deeply recessed black tread and metal track teeth. Its middle longitudinal split is clear but CLOSED in the standalone view. Render one coherent useful underground machine, not two unconnected separate tanks.

MATERIAL/STYLE: mature Japanese sci-fi concept illustration in the project's visual language, very precise dark blue-black variable lineweight, broad lit planes with convincing deep occlusion, hand-painted cel-shaded dimensionality, clean orange/ivory identity colors over dark steel articulation, a few scratches and realistic edge wear. Main forms must be strong before details; use large plates, not dozens of tiny squares. Strong sculptural volume and toy-collector appeal without photographed plastic. Avoid chibi, childish round smiles, short legs, bland square heads, text, glowing auras, excessive neon, exposed scaffold torsos, exploded layouts and random redesigns.
